create_selection_with_left_click: create a Selection instance using left_click_fn to select objects on left mouse click
create_selection_with_hover: create a Selection instance using hover_fn to select objects under the cursor every frame
update_selection_state: call update on a Selection instance to raycast and update the currently selected object
deselect_current_object: call deselect on a Selection instance to clear the currently selected object and reset state
filter_selectable_objects: pass a custom object_id_discriminator to Selection to filter which objects are selectable
